pages.title: One Crystal, Many Machines
pages.text: A wireless crystal avoids covering every machine face with Direct I/O crystals. Binder-link it into the crystal network, select it with the Binder, then use each target machine in turn—no crystal needs to touch them.

pages.title: Controlling the Flow
pages.text: Sneak-use the crystal empty-handed to switch mode. $(bold)Input$() pulls energy from the linked machines; $(bold)Output$() sends energy to them.
